R10_1_114.summary: Categorifiability remains unresolved. Further investigation of this case is deferred to the next research phase.
research: The exact signed-sphericalization audit supplies a spherical structure for any hypothetical categorification.

The exact dimension-character audit shows that a hypothetical complex categorification has a pseudo-unitary Galois conjugate. This is an existence reduction; it does not assert that every original category is pseudo-unitary.
No accepted model or exclusion is recorded. Surviving necessary tests do not prove existence.

R10_1_21.summary: A unitary model is the central condensation of the permutation equivariantization of PSU(2)_6 squared by 1+(f,f)_−.
research: The independent audit checks the central algebra and the balanced tensor product of the split fixed invertibles, obtaining the required group C2×C2.
All 196 source fusion products and all 1,000 original fusion coefficients were verified exactly.

R9_1_12.summary: A unitary model is obtained by a coherent C2 equivariantization of the nonregular triality C3 extension of Rep(D8).
research: The categorical audit constructs the action by coherent Azumaya Morita transport. Conjugate subgroup subextensions force the self-dual orbit pairing.
An independent exact replay reconstructs all 729 original coefficients from induction and restriction, and checks all 19 subgroups of D16.

R9_1_108.summary: A unitary model is obtained by twisting the triality involution by conjugation with a neutral invertible object.
research: A central lift makes the squared functor isomorphic to the identity. The action obstruction vanishes because H³(C2,C3)=0; the resulting neutral coherence and orbit duality give the required ring.
An independent exact replay reconstructs all 729 original coefficients from induction and restriction.

R9_1_62.summary: Excluded over the complex numbers by an exhaustive analysis of the three possible C2 de-equivariantization branches.
research: Solvability and trivial universal grading force a C2 equivariantization. The near-group and triality branches yield only the independently modeled rings R9_1_12 and R9_1_108.
The remaining rank-six branch has a characteristic central boson. It makes every original invertible sign available, reducing to the already classified near-group branch.

The triality quotient is forced by a direct exact enumeration of all nonnegative integer fusion tensors compatible with restriction. The exclusion does not depend on the completeness of an external quotient catalogue.
